test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He have / workers from / Ireland and France / in his factory.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the verb "**have**" with the singular subject "**He**."
 
• Singular subjects typically require the verb "**has**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**He has**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He **has** workers from Ireland and France in his factory."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "in his factory."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "Ireland and France"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "workers from"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
